verdict.rationale: Algolia documents official API clients for JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java, Swift, Kotlin and .NET, covered by its SLA. For frameworks it ships React InstantSearch and InstantSearch.js, and a community user confirms InstantSearch support for vanilla JS, React, Vue, Angular, iOS and Android. A first-party skill for migrating client code to the latest major version across these languages shows the clients are actively versioned. missing for 10: explicit release-cadence or currency evidence for each SDK, independent hands-on corroboration of the backend language clients.

support.subject: As a developer, official SDKs cover my language and framework, kept current across JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, and more
